name: Netherlands
sources: GDP: Dutch nominal GDP of roughly NLG 540bn in 1990 at the year-average 1.82 NLG/USD gives about $295bn (CBS national accounts; World Bank current-US$ series for 1990).
Inflation 2.5% (CBS consumer price index, 1990). The guilder was hard-pegged to the D-Mark, so De Nederlandsche Bank's special advances rate tracked the Bundesbank's; 8.5% is the late-1990 level.
Tax revenue 42% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990) and general government gross debt 77% of GDP (Maastricht definition, CBS).
Defence 2.6% of GDP (NATO defence expenditure series, 1990). Strength 12: two brigades forward in Germany under I (NL) Corps, no independent projection.
Oil 0.07 mbd: the Netherlands is a gas producer above all, with Schoonebeek and North Sea oil running near 70,000 barrels a day in 1990.
